text.description_html:
Fusion PH-G2-ORB, Rock Ridge Beveled Toilet Tissue Holder

If you want to update your bathroom with out going into the realm of modern design, the Rock Ridge Beveled Toilet Paper Holder has a contemporary feel that is perfect for traditional homes. It looks slightly distressed from the sandcasting, and that really grants the toilet tissue holder character. It comes in an oil rubbed bronze finish.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TR-G2 Rock Ridge Towel Ring, Fusion TB-G2 Rock Ridge Towel Bar, and Fusion RH-G2 Rock Ridge Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Round Mount Toilet Paper Holder:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
